summary: A Google DeepMind employee announced that users can now toggle visible watermarks on or off for images, videos and songs generated by Gemini and Flow (Nano Banana, Omni, Lyria), with Search support coming next, except where required by law.

practices.reason: A toggle for visible watermarks changes a UI/API option teams building on Gemini image/video/audio outputs may need to configure, but is a minor interface change.
practices.quote: You can now toggle visible watermarks on or off in Gemini and Flow, with Search coming next.
